reductions: Pack the existing 232 production bits into one storage felt instead of four slots.
Settle and apply each resource mutation in memory, then persist the final facts once.
Eliminate the 48-field arrival selector table; represent only populated slots with their original ordered list.
Remove inactive production timestamps and their rows; the activation command establishes the clock before enabling accrual.

ruledDivergences.cause: The pinned arrival accumulator can spend 10 + 20 but queue 20 + 20 for a newly arriving resource; malformed duplicate input creates resources.
ruledDivergences.rule: Reject duplicate resource ids in every transfer before gameplay mutation. An authenticated current-nonce ticket records rejection and consumes its nonce and order.
ruledDivergences.oracle: Retain the pinned defect in the oracle; compare native facts with the unchanged pre-action facts for this rejected input.

ruledDivergences.cause: Village placement is independent of its connected realm; that connection does not define troop-transfer eligibility.
ruledDivergences.rule: Remove connected-realm ownership checks for incoming village troops. Adjacent reinforcement has the same eligibility in both modes; Eternum accepts allied reinforcement previously rejected.
ruledDivergences.oracle: Keep the pinned Eternum rejection and assert the native transfer against the declared reinforcement facts. Generic transport mode rules remain separate.

normalization: Entity/account identities map bijectively; recorded execution time is oracle block time.

Inactive production has no accrual timestamp: both projections return zero when building_count is zero. Activation settles at the recorded command time before enabling production; an oracle fixture covers delayed activation.
